# cairn admin workflow run-failing

Enqueue a synthetic always-retrying job and run a real scheduler until the row dead-letters. Prints the resulting job_id.

## Help

```text
Enqueue a synthetic always-retrying job and run a real scheduler until the row dead-letters. Prints
the resulting job_id.

Usage: run-failing [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --kind <STRING>
          Workflow kind discriminator (default: test.e2e.always_retry)

      --max-attempts <U32>
          Retry ceiling before terminal failure (default: 2)

      --deadline-secs <U64>
          Polling deadline before reporting a timeout (default: 15)

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
